name: BRIGAND — unique shape-first chassis
notes:
Official brigand_ldt1, bespoke primary hull and weapon-bearing geometry (salvage_scout); unique head (cockpit), jointed two-stage arms, multi-stage legs, physically recessed counted muzzles. Miniature silhouette likeness still draft pending angle-by-angle refinement.
